response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS proportion FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins keep only analyses whose transaction record and trader both exist; each advancedbehavior row counts once, so a transaction analysed twice counts twice.
Traders with a NULL tradekind are grouped together as one NULL group and included in the total, since they still have an existing trader.
